recipe.visualDefinition: A three-panel vertical triptych featuring a single subject in different dynamic poses, set against alternating color-blocked backgrounds, with a heavy typographic footer on a solid white base.
coreVisualRelationships: Repetition of the subject across three distinct vertical zones
Contrast between the warm yellow outer panels and the cool blue-grey center panel
Heavy horizontal weight of the bottom text block grounding the verticality of the panels
Subject's red attire providing a consistent focal point across color shifts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-length figures, approximately 60% of total height, centered within their respective vertical thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in a dynamic 'one-leg-up' pose and the large blue title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Left-to-right scan across the three poses, then dropping down to the large-scale title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room around the figures within the panels to emphasize movement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted mustard yellow in the outer panels and off-white in the footer.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool slate blue-grey in the center panel.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson red for the subject's clothing and navy blue for the footer text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with a matte, printed texture feel; high value contrast between the white footer and the colored panels.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing in the footer
characterSpecificRedesigns: Question mark is oversized and integrated into the line flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between lowercase grotesque for the name and uppercase geometric for the title.
graphicDevices: Circular logo badge in top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque feel for the name.
Captures the wide, heavy geometric feel of the footer text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical triptych image. The left and right panels are mustard yellow; the center panel is slate blue-grey. In each panel, place a full-body photo of a man in a 1950s red suit in a different dancing pose. Add a solid white horizontal bar at the bottom occupying the lower 25% of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in black lowercase grotesque sans-serif across the top right. Add the main title in navy blue uppercase bold extended geometric sans-serif, centered in the white footer area.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly three vertical panels?
Is the footer text navy blue on a white background?
Is the artist name in lowercase?
Does the center panel color contrast with the outer panels?

avoid: Overlapping the subject with the footer text

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent lighting on the subject across all three panels
Ensure the white footer is a clean, solid block
Verify the 'wide' aspect ratio of the footer typography
Confirm the name is entirely lowercase
recipe.reuseFormula: Triptych Layout + Color Blocking + Extended Sans-Serif Footer
